Without this arm the three refusal cases below could all pass on nothing.

RULE 1 — a receipt dated inside its own pass cannot be constructed. The positive control comes first: the smallest lawful effectiveAt constructs. The EQUAL case is then pinned by itself, because strict-greater versus greater-or-equal is the branch a mutant flips and the one that would re-open same-pass feedback; then the earlier cases; then the source ref's own time, which counts as well as the observation; then an ABSENT source time, which is a refusal rather than a free pass.

RULE 2 and the injectivity cure. An unregistered kind, an unknown temporal branch, a missing role, an extra role and a REORDERING are each construction failures, while the four-role seasonal branch still constructs so the roster is not merely refusing everything. Then the ODQ §390.1 witness: the engineered pair collides under the sealed spelling against a NAMED literal and is DISTINCT through the live module; the three sibling seams follow; and two plainly distinct inputs read DISTINCT while identical input reads IDENTICAL, so an after-run reporting no collisions cannot be a witness that stopped comparing.

Then the structural proof, DRIVEN rather than asserted: adding EVERY excluded field at once leaves the spatial digest byte-identical while touching ONE roster field moves it — a whole-object hash would fail the first assertion, which is precisely the defect §10.1 forbids.

Same seed, key, variant and year replay byte-identically. A 48-row matrix is driven twice and compared, and asserted to hold 48 DISTINCT readings. The inertia law is then driven rather than described: a neighbour's 25 draws cannot move this entity's first draw; a changed year, a reroll salt, a sampleIndex and a mechanicId each move only what they should; and all-zero weights degrade to a uniform pick rather than silently to index 0.

No clock, ambient-randomness, locale or internationalization token is reachable from either new leaf. changeManifest._note: THE MONOTONE COMPONENTS (311.8.2(b) / 311.8.3), the first car of T-UC3. deriveMonotoneComponents(settlement, opts) answers what a town DUG and never filled in: crypts under what buries, the surge pit a dated year of mass death digs, undercrofts under what stores and the smuggler subset of those, workings at the dossier's own seams, and sealed vaults under what arms and what judges. MONOTONE IS STRUCTURAL, NOT HOPEFUL: no extent driver here can FALL. Burial demand reads deriveHighWater(...).population - T2R's constitutional peak, the only population reading that cannot go down - institution age grows with the calendar and nothing else, and a worked seam keeps the extent the town that dug it earned. Recession is therefore always a posture or an abandonment, never a shrink (311.8.3, use recedes and dug space never does). Re-derived at this base: 311 rows, 36 with minTier, 26 REDUNDANT, 10 ABOVE-BLOCK, 0 BELOW, and all three readers returned TRUE for all ten while generator-eligible was FALSE. The cure is `institutionAvailableAtTier`, reusing `tierAtLeast` from constants.js - the predicate institutionLifecycle already uses - on getInstitutionalCatalog and getInstitutionsForTier; getFullCatalogWithTierMeta keeps every row and reports `nativeTier` as the EFFECTIVE tier instead, because that view spans all tiers so nothing there was unreachable and what was wrong was the LABEL InstitutionalGrid renders. `'all'` is exempt by design and the walker pins the exemption. THE RULING CONTRADICTS 491's 'the tier block is the structural truth' framing, on the measurement - deleting minTier moves 97 of 420 rosters and moving the rows moves 108 while clobbering the city's own Smuggling network, and the reader fix costs ZERO - and the chair owns the correction. The honest frame is stated rather than assumed: priorityCategory divergence is systemic and owner-settled and the plausibility test's own header says so, so what identifies these five is the contiguous-run signature that header names PLUS the measured placement consequence. 3.6: two `facets` declarations on Underground city and Black market bazaar, which are explicitly subterranean in their own prose and seeded the undercity sheet ZERO times. THE SIBLING SHAPE WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG: the three Underground network rows declare BOTH clandestine and subterranean, and `clandestine` is a LIVE facet kind read by clandestineFacet.js whose settlementHasUnderways drives D6 couplings in supplyKernel, foodStockpile and settlementLifecycleFirstClass - copying it would ACTIVATE engine behaviour rather than declare an existing truth. Settled by execution at the charter's own base: the one-key form reproduces the charter's priced digest a542cc2e exactly, the two-key form yields 5ceac443. 3.1 tail: the 26 REDUNDANT minTier declarations deleted row-scoped rather than pattern-scoped, because nine CITY rows also read minTier metropolis and are the gates this car exists to honour. 3.2: `exclusiveGroup: 'religiousCenter'` deleted from the two CITY religious rows - the car's ONE roster shift, its own commit, chair-ruled against THE PROMISE.

THE COEXISTENCE AFFORDANCE, added by the chair REVISION of J-CH-3-2 (ODQ 538.5 revised). The exclusivity early return precedes the rng.chance draw, so a suppressed row consumes NO draw and un-suppressing one re-rolls the whole settlement - 81 of 420 rosters, of which only about 30 were the intended coexistence and the rest draw-sequence collateral. A row declaring `exclusiveGroupCoexists` stays IN its group, so coherenceRepairPass still refuses the same-group dependency add and the TOWN-tier `Monastery or friary` injection measures back at ZERO, but the group no longer BLOCKS it and its chance is drawn from rng.fork('exclusiveCoexist::<tier>::<category>::<name>'). The main sequence therefore stands exactly where it stood while the row was suppressed, and only the rosters that actually gain the row move: 30 of 420 settlements, 22 of 525 golden rows. A coexisting row also does not take the group over on selection, so a third member of the same group is blocked exactly as before. THIS IS A NEW ENGINE AFFORDANCE AND IS NAMED AS ONE: the skeptic panel variant hard-coded the group name inside this file, which is not shippable, so the permission had to become data. Its value outlives this car - it is how a catalog row can be un-suppressed or added WITHOUT re-rolling every existing seed, which is THE PROMISE expressed as a mechanism rather than as a hope. The fork label is prefixed and fully qualified because fork('a::b') and fork('a').fork('b') derive the same stream (kernel/prng.js).

THE PROSE SWEEP's variant half. 3.5 HK-6's two Eberron variants, and 3.4's two `town|Crafts|Tanners` variants - and 3.7's TWO `city|Criminal|Kidnapping ring` variants, which the charter did not name. Both of those assert the same claim the row's own exclusionConditions refute, and the variant pick is a hash over three entries, so a reader had a 2-in-3 chance of seeing the uncorrected sentence; 3.7 is widened to all three homes by 3.4's own reasoning. changeManifest._note: THE CELL ADDRESS AND THE ONE LEDGER. packFootprint took a mod-4 SLOT into one medial subdivision and the layer kept TWO counters over the same parcel (flagshipsAt for round-1 institutions, occupancy for everything else); because a footprint is a PURE FUNCTION of (parcel, slot, shrink), both leaks drew buildings at IDENTICAL COORDINATES rather than crowding a parcel — 26.42% of 53,420 drawn rows over the 504-row calibration corpus, with 5,932 of 5,932 duplicate groups inside a SINGLE parcel and 4,518 parcels holding more than the four cells the theorem afforded. The medial subdivision RECURSES, so cellAt reads the index as an unbounded base-4 ADDRESS (bounded for, never a while; an address past the tree returns null rather than wrapping) and containment stays a theorem by induction. One ledger replaces two and a flagship CONSUMES its cell while staying exempt from the per-parcel band and the total cap. The footprint also gains a DRESSED form — a size step and an optional corner truncation off one sceneDigest under its own aspect key, so no second carto: label is added and TC-2 determinism scan stays green unedited — because subcells 0,1,2 of any triangle are exact TRANSLATES of one another (20,000 of 20,000 integer triangles) and a unique cell alone would leave a one-shape vocabulary. The dwelling fill free term is clamped at zero, which is load-bearing once occupancy can exceed the band.

FOUR NEW NAMED BANDS AND ONE MOVED CALIBRATION. FOOTPRINT_FORM_VARIANTS bands the form vocabulary by tier (3/3/6/9/12/12, each a multiple of three because the size step is variant%3 and the cut slot floor(variant/3)) on the measured ground that PLAN_UNIT_CM_BY_TIER makes a thorp plan unit 10 cm to a metropolis 80 — a thorp is genuinely a dozen of the same cottage. FOOTPRINT_FORM_SHRINK_STEP is 45 permille, set so the three sizes of one class cannot cross the tightest 120-permille gap between adjacent shrink classes and make prominence a lie. FOOTPRINT_CORNER_CUT_PERMILLE is 340 and FOOTPRINT_CELL_MAX_DEPTH is 5 (1,364 cells in one parcel against a measured corpus worst case of 29). CARTOGRAPHY_CALIBRATION.MAX_BUILDING_ROW_BYTES moves 443 -> 450 because the MEASUREMENT moved: a truncated cell is a quadrilateral and a fourth plan point costs a row about seven bytes. No taste knob and no density dial moves.
